Subject: Endpoint coverage inventory + exec approval request

Team —

We need to get a consolidated view of our endpoint security renewals and an ask for exec-level approval to proceed on a two-year commit where it makes sense. Specifically: MDM, EDR, and vulnerability scanning (current vendors + renewal months, renewal amounts, any active negotiations or credits).

I attached a starter inventory (endpoint_inventory.csv) — please fill in the following columns by EOD Friday: vendor, product, contract_end, annual_spend, auto_renew (yes/no), current_discount, and notes on any ongoing migration work or technical blockers.

Ask: once we have the inventory, I want a short recommendation (one line) for each product: renew, renegotiate, combine, or migrate. We will present a consolidated ask to Finance/Exec on Monday (Dec 7) for a provisional budget hold.

Quick priorities:
- EDR: confirm whether our current license coverage matches active headcount (we suspect a ~6% drift).
- MDM: confirm device types and whether any legacy macOS agents need upgrade before renewal.
- Vuln scanner: confirm frequency of scans and whether we’re under-utilizing paid features.

Thanks — a concise reply is perfect here (I don’t need long paragraphs). I’ll schedule 30 mins after the inventory is in to align on the ask.

Laura Bennett
Head of IT Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the heads up and the inventory. Quick answers from our side to help you populate the sheet:

- Current contract for SecureWave EDR (pro) for Redwood Inference expires 2027-02-15. Current annual list price: $210,000. You are on a 15% enterprise discount; renewals in Q1 typically include a standard 5% loyalty adjustment for multi-year commitments.
- We have a 2% drift on active endpoints vs licensed seats in your tenant (we ran a sweep last month).
- SecureWave MDM module is on the same contract and expires 2027-02-15. The MDM agent requires an update for a macOS 14 compatibility fix (we can bundle the update into the renewal).
- Vulnerability scanner add-on (SecureScan) is on a consumption model; last 12-month spend was $34,500. If you convert to an annual prepaid block you can save ~18%.

Quote attached: SecureWave-Quote-Redwood-2027.pdf (summary with 1- and 2-year pricing and EDR seat reconciliation). We can do a 10% additional discount for a 24-month commit if you sign by Jan 15, 2027.

Hope this helps — happy to jump on a quick call with Marcus or Neha to walk the quote.

Best,
Support Team / SecureWave
support@securewave.com
